findings.evidence: Both statements use only Finset.range, integer subtraction, conditionals and complex casts; their proofs depend only on finite sums and arithmetic, with no Fourier or kernel dependencies.
findings.fix: Relocate and export the counting identities in a finite-sum or interval module with names describing their combinatorial content.
findings.issue: Both sum_fourier_pairs (line 113) and sum_fourier_pairs_int (line 138) hide general finite-difference counting identities, preventing reuse outside this Fourier proof.

summary: The interface hides reusable counting infrastructure and omits a public defining equation for the kernel.
